title: Uber and Zipline launch autonomous drone deliveries, starting with Uber Eats customers in Spring, Texas, with plans for 1M deliveries per day by the end of 2029 (Kirsten Korosec/TechCrunch)
summary: Kirsten Korosec / TechCrunch: Uber and Zipline launch autonomous drone deliveries, starting with Uber Eats customers in Spring, Texas, with plans for 1M deliveries per day by the end of 2029 — Uber Eats customers in a Houston suburb can now have their food delivered by a Zipline drone, the first commercial launch under …
